call_direction: Public producer lazily calls validation.report_projection(kind="completion-report"); it never assesses independently.

The operation evaluates the requested mode once, merges its trusted non-error input findings using the existing bounded collector, and calls completion_summary. That helper only projects the supplied tuple; it never calls validate_snapshot, report_projection, another producer or rule family.
Malformed input goes directly from actual validate_inputs findings to the same pure summary with structural_valid=false; no semantic operation is constructed.
completion_preflight reuses the accepted coverage_preflight captured-input resource bound, as parity_preflight already does. Budgeting is not coverage evaluation.
DiscoveryReport remains the bounded immutable carrier. report_rendering imports no validation/completion producer; it only formats the supplied JsonObject under ReportBudget.

completion.assessment_state: available | unavailable; structural_valid alone selects this label, not semantic success
completion.blocking_findings: ascending zero-based indices of error findings in envelope.findings
completion.findings_complete: false iff FINDINGS_LIMIT is present, otherwise true
completion.mode_label: closed map: structural -> Structural validation; discovery-complete -> Discovery completion; parity-complete -> Parity completion; planning -> Planning prerequisite
completion.next_actions: array of {action: str, finding_indices: list[int]}; one row per exact next_action string, sorted by action, with sorted unique indices
completion.planning_prerequisite: profile.completion_gates.planning_prerequisite only for available planning assessment; otherwise null
completion.retained_finding_counts: object with error, warning, info nonnegative integers counting only the retained tuple, including truncation marker
completion.warning_findings: ascending zero-based indices of warning findings in envelope.findings

envelope.counts: sorted dict[str,int] of existing non-control/non-report artifact kinds when structural_valid; null when malformed/unavailable (never invented zero)
envelope.findings: existing bounded, deduplicated, finding_key-ordered list of full Finding.to_dict objects, including trusted input warnings and FINDINGS_LIMIT
envelope.mode: one exact root mode: structural | discovery-complete | parity-complete | planning
envelope.validation_result: fail iff retained selected-mode findings contain an error; malformed core always fail

finding_and_mode_rules: Top-level findings is the single complete retained diagnostic source; index lists and actions do not duplicate/rewrite Finding payloads or infer new rules. Group action text by exact string, without trimming/casefolding that could merge different instructions. Indices retain all original codes, paths, pointers, related identities and severities.

No selected finding may disappear merely because an action is duplicated. Bound input work, grouping and retained output before allocation with ReportBudget; output exhaustion raises ReportLimitError, never a partial successful envelope. Truncated input remains fail through FINDINGS_LIMIT and findings_complete=false.

Stale/conflicting reference, incomplete artifact and pending scenario diagnostics come from existing selected-mode rules. Preserve unknown codes. No secondary code-to-readiness classifier is introduced.

A structural pass is labeled structural only. Planning resolves the existing configured prerequisite through evaluate; none still includes base safety checks. Do not evaluate unrelated completion modes merely to fill presentation fields.
Reject agent-output and unsupported modes at all public completion producer/planning boundaries. Completion does not issue output_valid, required-output grants or a host gate receipt.

No readiness field is emitted. True empty validated populations use existing empty counts/zero retained findings; unavailable artifact counts are null. Original diagnostic counts remain known even when semantic assessment is unavailable.

Completion warning preservation uses operation.input_findings only in completion projection; existing coverage/parity projection bytes remain unchanged where unaffected. Public validate_snapshot retains its existing aggregate input findings.

Derived report mismatch checks remain outside canonical core projection to avoid self-reference. Stale generated views can still block validate_snapshot/prospective publication; completion generation does not suppress or rewrite that gate.
legacy_adapter: Retain the existing two-input CLI flags, validator injection seams, stdout/optional legacy output route, aggregate validation error behavior and exception propagation. This is explicitly legacy artifact compatibility, not a v2 graph-mode CLI (P6 owns service/CLI authority).

Runtime legacy_summary reuses accepted bounded coverage_report.build_coverage_rows and parity_report.build_parity_rows. Explicit v1 uses actual unit/row shapes; unversioned data remains compatibility-only; explicit v2 input is rejected at these helpers.

Legacy summary shape is coverage_ledger:{present:true,entry_count:len(coverage_rows)}, parity_matrix:{present:true,entry_count:len(parity_rows)}, validation_scope:"legacy-artifact-compatibility-only". Omit readiness, v2 schema_version, completion-report artifact_kind and completion gate status. The label does not assert injected validators performed real schema validation.

Legacy render_completion_report performs bounded deterministic pretty JSON only. The seven existing completion callers change authority assertions accordingly; four io tests retain legacy-only semantics. New v2 mode/publication tests call the runtime snapshot API.
malformed_core: Retain original ordered input findings and next actions, validation_result=fail, counts=null, assessment_state=unavailable and planning_prerequisite=null. No semantic validator traversal or fabricated population/completion result.

This read-only diagnostic is renderable but cannot make malformed input valid, publish through structural mutation validation or authorize planning. SnapshotValidation still binds full snapshot.sha256; report envelope binds semantic report_input_digest.

performed: Read existing preparation/approved prerequisite and shared model signatures; write only this contract artifact. No source/test edits, suites, new research, staging, Git or checkpoint changes.
proof_contract: Three ownership lists are nonoverlapping. No worker changes another list or a predecessor helper without coordinator authorization. No source/test/script may exceed500 physical lines; obtain a cohesive split before exceeding it.

Retain exact unchanged-body proofs and accepted P5-T1/final accepted P5-T2 contracts. Keep mechanical relocation evidence separate from semantic warning/completion changes. No blanket predecessor rerun.

Focused new cases cover all four selected modes, agent-output rejection, warning-only pass, malformed diagnostics, truncation/error status, duplicate actions with retained target context, stale/conflicting/incomplete/pending findings, both views, safe replacement and forbidden authored writes.

Preserve Set D population from the prior delta (45 function definitions, not claimed executed case count), coverage/parity byte contracts and once-only assessment/carrier identity assertions. Native harness reuse requires a separate explicit release after static gates.
remaining_gate: Accepted/pushed/remote-verified P5-T2 and coordinator implementation release; this artifact alone grants no execution authority.
rendering: DiscoveryReport.to_json remains the existing canonical LF JSON. Markdown embeds the same detached fields and uses the fixed heading # Discovery completion report plus the existing JSON fence layout.

Shared Markdown extraction preserves exact coverage/parity heading/escaping/budget/newline bytes and existing fallback behavior for other already-supported kinds. Only completion receives its explicit new heading.
Neither renderer evaluates rules, changes status, adds findings or counts, resolves paths or performs I/O.
report_only_planning: plan_completion_report accepts captured baseline and explicit caller-authenticated root grants; it does not mint grants, accept caller-rendered bytes or take analyst invocation context.

Rebuild one authoritative report from baseline.snapshot, then derive JSON and Markdown bytes. Require precisely the two matching kind/id/path grants for configured reports/completion-report.json and .md. Derive prior expected_sha256 from captured files, or null for absence. Call existing plan_mutation with those changes and no invocation.

Caller uses existing commit_mutation(plan, writer=trusted_writer, dry_run=...) unchanged. No direct write_report or new I/O adapter. Preserve exact identity/CAS, fresh capture, dry-run/no-write, identical-byte skipping and operational failure semantics.

An honest selected-mode failure report can publish only if the prospective graph is structurally valid. Malformed input and wrong/stale/grantless requests remain rejected. Never write authored source/evidence/contracts or treat the invalidation callback as new authority.
scope: Unchanged P5-T3 plan; approved cohesive extraction, existing shared report models and root mutation APIs. No new validator, report schema or native authority.
sequence: First mechanically move _Validation and its bounded _findings helper from validation.py to validation_operation.py. Preserve bodies, mode caching, source-completion reuse and complete_parity/complete_dimensions; retain public validation.py entrypoints and ValidationMode/SnapshotValidation types. Freeze mapped AST/body coverage proof before semantic edits.
Update only the existing once-only observer use-site in test_parity_report_projection.py. Keep observers of validation._schema_findings and public report_projection at their existing module.

Then add trusted input_findings storage and completion dispatch, shared pure summary projection and malformed-core completion diagnostics. Both validate_snapshot report recomputation and report_projection generation pass their actual validate_inputs result to the same operation; never accept caller-authored validation results.
Freeze the shared shape/signatures below before disjoint producer and rendering/adapter changes. Final composition gates bind the accepted P5-T2 candidate and all resulting bytes.
